title_zh: 农夫山泉：大自然的搬运工
title_en: Chinese Companies (13/20): Nongfu Spring, Nature's Porter
note_en: The famous slogan 我们不生产水，我们只是大自然的搬运工 "We don't make water. We're just nature's porters" repeats the subject 我们 in both halves. In ordinary speech the second 我们 could be dropped, but repeating it, together with the contrast 不…只是… "not ... merely ...," gives the line rhythm and punch, a device common in Chinese advertising and speeches, much like English "We don't ..., we ..."
